mapper.select: SELECT C_FAQ_SEQ SEQ, S_FAQ_QUESTION FAQ_QUESTION, S_FAQ_ANSWER FAQ_ANSWER, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_FAQ_LIST ORDER BY C_FAQ_SEQ
SELECT C_FAQ_SEQ SEQ, S_FAQ_QUESTION FAQ_QUESTION, S_FAQ_ANSWER FAQ_ANSWER, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_FAQ_LIST WHERE C_FAQ_SEQ = #{seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LD_FAQ_LIST (C_FAQ_SEQ, S_FAQ_QUESTION, S_FAQ_ANSWER, C_USE_YN, S_REG_ID, D_REG_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(C_FAQ_SEQ), 0) + 1, #{faqQuestion}, #{faqAnswer}, 'Y', 'admin', NOW() FROM T_LD_FAQ_LIST
mapper.update: UPDATE T_LD_FAQ_LIST SET C_USE_YN = 'N' WHERE C_FAQ_SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE T_LD_FAQ_LIST SET C_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE C_FAQ_SEQ = #{seq}
